public.title: The Missing Watch
public.setup: On Saturday 12 September 2026, between 14:00 and 15:00, a silver pocket watch was stolen from the display case at the Covent Garden Market Hall. Security footage shows a figure in a grey coat taking it and fleeing toward the underground.

suspects.name: Maya Patel
suspects.alibi: I was riding the District line from Edgware Road to Tower Hill, boarding at 14:20 and alighting at 14:35, as shown by my Oyster tap-in/tap-out record.

suspects.name: Liam O'Connor
suspects.alibi: I was having lunch at Pret a Manger on the Strand; my receipt is timestamped 14:12.

suspects.name: Aisha Khan
suspects.alibi: I was at the Fitness First gym in South Kensington; my entry log shows I swiped in at 14:48 and left at 15:20.

public.brief: One of these alibis collides with a real public fact in London this week. Search the live web, pick your evidence, and name the thief.

hidden.why_impossible: The District line had no service between Edgware Road and Tower Hill on 12‑13 September 2026, so she could not have been on a train there at that time.
hidden.fact: District line has no service between Edgware Road and Tower Hill, and between Ealing Broadway and Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Wimbledon on Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 September 2026.
hidden.fact_en: District line has no service between Edgware Road and Tower Hill, and between Ealing Broadway and Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Wimbledon on Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 September 2026.
hidden.quote: Saturday, September 12 and Sunday, September 13: No service between Edgware Road and Tower Hill, and Ealing Broadway and Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Wimbledon due to track work.
hidden.place: Edgware Road to Tower Hill, and Ealing Broadway to Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Wimbledon, London

verdicts.reason: The fact states that the District line had no service between Edgware Road and Tower Hill on Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 September 2026. Therefore, it is impossible for someone to have ridden the District line between those stations at any time on those dates, as claimed in the alibi.

The fact only states that District line service is suspended on specific sections; it does not prohibit being at Pret a Manger on the Strand, which is not on those sections. Therefore the alibi is not strictly impossible.

The fact only states that District line service is suspended on certain segments; it does not prevent someone from being at the Fitness First gym in South Kensington, as they could arrive by other transport (e.g., walking, bus, or other tube lines) or already be there. Therefore the alibi is not strictly impossible.
